data.review_body:
I have been ordering from Ali Express for years. I know when I receive my packages I they get to be a little banged up, but the contents are great inside. I also wait some time to receive my items, and I have learned to deal with that. The sellers I purchase from, are great and I haven’t been able to find the same merchandise anywhere else, so I adapted and it works for me. What I can’t take is no regard for me as a customer and the money I spend. Their customer service is unhelpful and robotic. They use a logistics company called “ Cainio Express “ I don’t know if they have a new driver and he is just incompetent as well as there customer service. But, I need to receive the orders I place. The last like 17 items I have purchased, which I believe was broken down in about 6 packages were delivered to an unknown home. This has happened on n the past, but with items under $20 and I just let it go. Ali Express will not refund you when your package is delivered. They don’t care if it was sent to the wrong home. Nor, will they get you to a supervisor to rectify the situation. They don’t do that there. They will not refund or reship. They tell you to contact the logistics company. That was horrible. They they gave me a lost and stolen package pdf certificate and still denied my refund, why? This logistics company is not delivering the merchandise. Ali Express, Please do something about this, it’s a huge problem.  I received a reply for order numbers and additional information, for some reason there was a system glitch and I was unable to add the order numbers and my phone number. I have escalated cases and been denied refunds. I was told to submit information from the logistics company which I did for the first order and I was told to get more information. I have asked to speak with a supervisor or someone who can help several times and told by customer service there was no additional help and they were very rude to me. How can I get someone to help me? This has been like over 11 items already delivered to the wrong address, with no help from logistics and they keep delivering to the same house because I can see it in the photos they provide. 
Thank you for replying, I have placed about 3 orders this week and I am afraid of Cainio getting assigned to my orders. Your customer service told me they were blocked from picking up my packages, and I would receive an email confirmation. I never did, and I called back the next rep told me that I would have to reach out to each seller individually. I have done that, they have no say on who the packages get assigned to. Please help me. I need my packages.
